svg.title: How many inputs each version of my Rust port got wrong, by test set
svg.desc: First port: 0 of 35 in fast-anything verify with the app as workload, 10 of 56 with a workload that includes two nasty calls, 2 of 3 hand-written inputs, 3341 of 20000 random inputs, 128 of 20000 random inputs without file separators. Fixed port: 0 in every set.

text.font-family: Work Sans, Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Green on verify, wrong in the wild

text.font-family: Work Sans, Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Inputs where the Rust port and the Python original disagree. Both ports passed verify when the app itself was the workload.

svg.text: Source: my runs on 2026-11-23 (fast-anything 0.8.0, Python 3.13.5, Rust 1.85.1). Random sets use threshold 0.0 so every pair is compared; seed 23.

text.font-family: Work Sans, Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The random inputs are deliberately mean. My actual blog posts trip neither bug, which is why verify only saw them once I fed it the nasty calls.
